aboutText: One 8th Joinery has been serving Yarraville and the surrounding areas with high-quality cabinet making and joinery services. Specialising in outdoor spaces, living areas, offices, and bedrooms, we deliver custom solutions tailored to your needs. Our team is dedicated to craftsmanship and customer satisfaction, ensuring every project is completed to the highest standards in Melbourne's west.
servicesText: At One 8th Joinery, we offer a range of services including outdoor structures, living space cabinetry, office solutions, and bedroom wardrobes. Each service is customised to fit your specific requirements and lifestyle. We pride ourselves on delivering joinery that enhances both functionality and aesthetics in Yarraville homes.
